newsitem.title: USA: Valero Energy sets shareholder rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Valero Energy sets shareholder rights plan.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp's board of directors said Friday it has established a shareholder rights plan to protect itself in case it is the target of a takeover.
Valero said it distributed a dividend of one preferred share purchase right for each share of Valero common stock currently held on July 31.

The company said in a statement that each right will entitle shareholders to buy one one-hundreth of a share of a newly issued series of junior participating preferred stock at an exercise price of $100.

Valero said the rights will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires 15 percent of its common stock. If that happens, the company said, the plan allows shareholders to use the rights to purchase common stock at half price. Before that time, the company said, the right's are redeemable for one cent per right at the option of the board of directors. The options expire on June 30, 2007.
The board also said it has the option of reducing the 15 percent threshold to not less than 10 percent.
